top5.text: Two Russian missiles and probably a drone fell in south-east Poland during a strike on Ukraine; no one was hurt. Tusk called it deliberate provocation and openly disagreed with the US reading of such incidents.
US stocks slid into correction: the S&P 500 fell 3.7% and the Nasdaq 5.3% as the AI sell-off deepened.
Nikhil Gupta was sentenced to 235 months in the Pannun murder-for-hire case; India has not commented.

US.text: S&P 500 (-3.7%) and Dow fell into correction and the Nasdaq dropped 5.3% on Nov 20 as an AI-stock rout deepened; Nvidia fell about 14%.
Trump publicly urged Nvidia's board to give ousted CEO Jensen Huang 'a second chance'; the board has said it will not reinstate him.
Trump ordered federal contractors to alert the White House about congressional requests and to withhold material it deems privileged, ahead of a Democratic Congress.
The Senate passed a sweeping bipartisan permitting overhaul (BAAJA) 62-33; it now goes to the House, where Democrats want changes.
The administration asked the Supreme Court to let the EPA cancel $16bn in Biden-era green-bank climate grants after losing in the DC Circuit.

Work on ul. Witosa starts 25 November, narrowing the road towards Kurdwanów to one lane. The design was revised after residents protested about trees.

India.text: Odisha reports no deaths or major damage from Cyclone Akvan after evacuating about 3.7 lakh people; power was largely restored within hours.
Ladakh held its first panchayat and municipal polls since becoming a UT, despite opposition from Leh groups; counting is on Dec 4.

SEBI proposes dropping extra ownership disclosures for offshore funds, unwinding a post-Adani 2023 rule, to attract foreign investors.
The Supreme Court stayed the Madras HC Thiruparankundram ruling but allowed a one-time, officials-only Karthigai lamp lighting on Nov 24.

city.text: On Saturday morning (06:00) the air was 'very good' at all six GIOŚ stations in Kraków: Krasińskiego, Bujaka, Bulwarowa, Złoty Róg, Piastów and Swoszowice. The AQICN index was 26 (good) at 04:00.
Expect drizzle and about 4–5°C on Saturday, with sleet or snow in the foothills. Sunday is around 6°C by day and 1°C at night, and Monday 3°C, falling to -2°C overnight.
Buses 238 and 248 are on temporary routes until 25 Nov while the Modlniczka junction is resurfaced. Lines 268, 278 and 288 are back on ul.
The bike path along Park Szwedzki (al. Solidarności) is under repair from 23 to 30 Nov; follow the temporary signs.
World Balloon Festival, with more than 100,000 balloons, at EXPO Kraków (ul. Galicyjska 9), 21–22 Nov, 9:00–20:00, ticketed.
Football on Saturday: Cracovia v Jagiellonia at home at 14:45 (expect traffic around ul. Kałuży), and Radomiak v Wisła away at 20:15.

US–Poland.text: Tusk said he disagrees with the US reading of Russian missile incursions after Trump called them a mistake, and offered US officials access to the wreckage.
Poland's energy minister said the EPC contract with Westinghouse-Bechtel for the first nuclear plant should be signed by the end of 2026.

US–India.text: A US judge sentenced Nikhil Gupta to 235 months in prison for the foiled plot to kill Pannun; India has not commented.

US–India.text: The FAA finished its safety audit of India's DGCA on Nov 20; results, and India's Category 1 status, are expected only in months.
An NCB–DEA operation broke up an Indian network shipping about 500,000 prescription opioid and psychotropic pills to US buyers; six people were arrested.
India's MEA declined to judge the Trump–Xi–Putin summit, saying it awaits a fuller account of concrete outcomes.

rules.name: Executive order protecting executive privileges in federal contracting (contractor notice of congressional requests)
rules.changes: Federal contractors and subcontractors must notify the White House and their contracting agencies about congressional requests related to their work, coordinate responses and privilege claims, and withhold material the White House deems privileged.
rules.affects: Federal contractors (defence, tech, consulting) and congressional oversight committees, especially the incoming Democratic majorities

rules.name: 2027 property tax rates resolution
rules.changes: Keeps 2026 property tax rates for flats (1.25 zł/m²) and 'other land' (0.77 zł/m²) instead of raising them to the maximum.
rules.affects: All Kraków property owners. Residents avoid the rise, businesses pay slightly more. The city gives up about 17m zł of planned extra revenue.

rules.name: Proposal to remove additional disclosure requirements for high-risk offshore funds/FPIs
rules.changes: Would scrap the extra beneficial-ownership disclosures imposed in 2023 on offshore funds with concentrated holdings in Indian companies, relying instead on existing beneficial-ownership norms.
rules.affects: Foreign portfolio investors and offshore funds investing in Indian equities.

deepDive.domain: Society: education, labor, immigration + Environment, energy & disasters + Infrastructure, transport & housing
deepDive.title: Sirens, permits and bridges: who gets protected, and how fast
deepDive.body:
Saturday's theme is the plumbing of daily life, and this week it was tested.

**Poland: the warning came after the blast.** The government centre (RCB) sent a general alert at 2:31, but the phone alert for the Biłgoraj area went out at 6:30 and local sirens a minute later. The missile hit at 6:36, and several residents say they heard nothing until the explosion ([WP](https://wiadomosci.wp.pl/rosyjskie-rakiety-i-dron-spadly-w-polsce-wszystko-co-wiadomo-7353117235648544a)). The wójt of Aleksandrów says outlying villages have too few sirens, and local leaders learn no sooner than residents ([Polsat News](https://www.polsatnews.pl/wiadomosc/2026-11-20/rosyjski-pocisk-przelecial-nad-jego-gmina-wojt-wskazuje-na-powazny-problem/)). Tusk has ordered a review of the alert timing.

**India: the drill worked, the costs moved.** Odisha's evacuation of about 3.7 lakh people before Cyclone Akvan, its third storm threat in 24 days, kept deaths at zero. Power was almost fully back within seven hours ([OdishaBytes](https://odishabytes.com/cyclone-akvan-tpsodl-restores-power-to-10-69-lakh-consumers-achieves-nearly-99-restoration-within-7-hours/)). The costs fell instead on cancelled trains, waterlogged cities and standing paddy in Jharkhand, where crop-loss surveys have been ordered ([Kisan India](https://www.kisanindia.in/agriculture-money/cyclone-akvan-crop-damage-compensation-farmers-chhattisgarh-jharkhand-odisha-170110.html)). Delhi's air, meanwhile, is back to 'very poor'.

**US: faster building, fewer lawsuits.** The Senate's 62-33 permitting overhaul (BAAJA) would speed up environmental reviews, limit project lawsuits and give FERC power over interstate power lines. Backers say it helps clean and fossil projects alike; environmental groups and 17 Democratic states say it guts protections ([CBS](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/senate-bipartisan-permitting-reform-bill-energy-baaja-trump/)). The AI data-centre boom is driving the grid side of this fight.

**Kraków: a smaller zone, a changing centre.** The plan to cut the Clean Transport Zone from about 196 km² to about 1 km² goes to residents from 27 Nov ([KRKnews](https://krknews.pl/konsultacje-sct-w-krakowie/)). An opinion column in Krakowski Raport argues the Old Town is emptying of residents and everyday shops; this is analysis, not news ([Krakowski Raport](https://krakowskiraport.pl/artykul/3243-krakow-pieknieje-ale-coraz-trudniej-w-nim-zyc-co-dzieje-sie-z-centrum-miasta)).

The common thread: each system is judged by what reaches the last village, field or street.
